annotations.title: Check a site once: what search engines and agents find

description: Wraps POST /check. Check a site once: what search engines and agents find. Reads a domain's robots.txt, homepage, sitemap, 404 page and the files agents look for, scores it A to F, and keeps the report at /check/<domain> (or only at its own address, with private). Send JSON: a form post is taken only from our own pages. A report from the last 10 minutes is answered instead of a new look (fresh). A site whose owner asked us not to look, or whose robots.txt names site-monitor, isn't read. Needs no key.
